title: Calculate an evidence-based weighted pipeline
prompt:
Forecast policy assigns proposal=50 percent and discovery=20 percent. Deal A: proposal, 100000 cents. B: discovery, 200000 cents. C: lost, 900000 cents, contributes zero. Calculate the weighted total.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. weighted_pipeline_cents: integer.
remediation_hints: Use the supplied stage probabilities and exclude lost deals.
